title: Service agreement records from practice session B

context.question: Who must perform each narrow task, and what does the supplied evidence demonstrate?

controls.evidence_note: Platform OS maintenance evidence meets the stated patch window.
Customer-deployed dependency still has the specified unfixed issue.
Current tenant members match the approved access list.
Provider supplied a successful in-scope backup job record.
No customer acceptance check of restored records was supplied.

artifacts.service-description.txt:
Fictional agreement. No cloud account exists.
B1 Orchard App is PaaS: the provider operates the underlying OS and runtime; the customer deploys and patches its own report application and dependencies.
B2 The customer chooses tenant users and data sharing settings.
B3 This purchased plan explicitly includes provider operation of a daily copy of the named application data. This statement does not guarantee retention or recovery time.
B4 The customer must check whether restored records satisfy its business needs.
artifacts.checks.txt:
Synthetic supplied evidence.
E1 Platform OS maintenance evidence meets the stated patch window. Team claims customer owns OS patching.
E2 Customer-deployed dependency still has the specified unfixed issue. Team claims provider owns application code patching.
E3 Current tenant members match the approved access list. Team claims customer owns access review.
E4 Provider supplied a successful in-scope backup job record. Team claims provider creates copies.
E5 No customer acceptance check of restored records was supplied. Team claims provider owns restore acceptance.
